hf_full_vocabulary_quality.recommendation: This CPTC/H16 DEFAULT pipeline regresses quality on both measured cohorts. Keep experimental and opt-in; do not claim a quality win or a failure of the full paper.

limits: No per-arm KV capacity difference was observed; all arms were pinned to the same 16 GiB/rank manual KV budget.
Model loading GiB and graph capture GiB are rounded (2 dp) server log lines, not allocator counters; no allocator/peak metrics exist in serve.log.
Physical VRAM is whole-device sysfs before/after the quality pass, includes KV, graphs, allocator reserves, driver and other processes.
Native PPL is exact for the observed tokens but sparse: only top-1 logprobs plus the actual-token logprob/rank are stored, so no full-vocabulary KL or distribution metrics are derivable.
HF full-vocabulary KL/PPL come from the separate prior HF dense export study and are not a native-kernel measurement.
MTP2 graph-capture line is negative (-0.72 GiB) as logged; treat it as an unreliable delta, not a memory saving.
Storage tensor-byte deltas from the prior HF study do not imply KV capacity changes.

parent_verification.physical_vram_interpretation: Before/after snapshots bracket the native-quality phase; growth is not causally isolated to allocator or KV state and is not peak or weight-only memory.
